resources.string: Photopult
How will you use this phone?
One phone takes the photo, the other controls it from a distance
📷 This phone is the camera
Put it on a tripod — it becomes the camera
🎮 This phone is the remote
Control the camera: preview, zoom, shutter
A few permissions are needed
So the phones can find each other and take photos, the app needs access. Nothing is sent anywhere — everything works offline.
Camera — to take photos
Bluetooth and Wi-Fi — so the other phone can find this one without internet or a router
Location — the system requires it to find nearby devices (your coordinates are never used)
Allow
It won\'t work without access
The app can\'t connect the phones until you grant access. Open settings and allow the required items.
Open settings
Try again
This phone isn\'t supported
Connecting without internet needs Google Play services, which this device doesn\'t have. Unfortunately the app can\'t work here.
Update Google Play services
Please update Google Play services so the app can work.
Camera mode arrives in the next stage
Remote mode arrives in the next stage
